Header shows real data: MASS 6,328, Saved=1, Unlocked=2, Member since 2026, 'Verified Agent' badge visible. All 18 standard menu rows + Admin Cockpit + Sign-out button exist with correct testIDs. All 18 routes resolve to the expected target URL (menu-wallet→/wallet, menu-my-unlocks→/unlocks, menu-saved-properties→/saved-properties, menu-saved-searches→/saved-searches, menu-earn-tokens→/earn, menu-become-an-agent→/become-agent, menu-list-a-property→/submit-property, menu-agent-workspace→/agent-workspace, menu-agent-plans→/agent-plans, menu-provider-dashboard→/provider-dashboard, menu-improve-my-property→/improve, menu-my-ad-campaigns→/ads, menu-my-documents→/my-documents, menu-identity-verification→/identity-verification, menu-notifications→/notifications, menu-settings→/settings, menu-help-&-support→/help, menu-about-amass→/about). The 5 new screens (/saved-properties, /my-documents, /identity-verification, /help, /about) load, render their testIDs (saved-back/saved-explore, docs-back, idv-back/idv-cta, help-back/help-email/help-chat/help-privacy/help-terms/faq-0..4, about-back/about-privacy/about-terms/about-contact) and back navigation works. ui_bugs.issue: Alert.alert('Sign out?') confirmation dialog does not render on React Native Web (no window.confirm fallback). Tapping sign-out-button on web preview silently does nothing visible. Works on native. Consider using a RN-web-compatible modal confirm for parity.

Backend consistency between favorite_ids and favorites listing should be reconciled.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/my-documents.tsx used `unlock-${u.id}` and `rep-${r.id ?? r._id}` as keys. When those IDs were undefined (common for walletUnlocks that don't expose id), the same key was reused across all items → console 'Encountered two children with the same key' warnings and a visible red error toast. Fixed to composite keys `unlock-${idx}-...` and `rep-${idx}-...`.

Menu testID derivation uses label-slug (e.g. 'Help & Support' → 'menu-help-&-support'). The '&' is an unusual character in a testID; works but may collide with CSS/selector escaping in some automation tooling. Consider sanitizing non-alphanum to '-'.

/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx: initial fetches `api.favoriteIds()` and `api.walletUnlocks()` have no auth-guard; if run before auth hydrates, they fail silently and the stat renders '—' briefly. Acceptable but could gate on `user` presence.

Agent Workspace, Provider Dashboard, and Admin Cockpit entries ignore `requires` for admin (no gating pill for admin-only). Fine for this demo account (admin), but consider adding `requires: 'admin'` metadata if non-admin users ever reach that row.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope route wiring and new-screen rendering checks passed

context_for_next_testing_agent: When testing menu rows from Profile on web preview (390x844), the bottom tab bar overlays menu items near y=800+. Scroll the ScrollView with page.mouse.wheel BEFORE clicking (scrollIntoView on the DOM node does not scroll the RN ScrollView). Without scrolling, clicks on 'Earn Tokens' / 'Become an Agent' / later rows will pass through to the 'Market' tab button and navigate to /marketplace — this is a Playwright artifact, not a product bug.
rca_of_issue: my-documents duplicate-key bug: walletUnlocks records lack a top-level `id` field (payload uses property+timestamp without explicit document id). The map callback keyed by `unlock-${u.id}` therefore produced `unlock-undefined` for every row, triggering React dup-key warnings and surfacing a visible red error toast. Fix: build composite key `unlock-${idx}-${u.id ?? u._id ?? p.id ?? 'x'}` and same pattern for representations. Verified: 3 → 0 dup-key errors after Expo restart.
